gens.prompt:
Single shot, handheld iPhone at hip height in a sunny backyard garden. A cream snow Bengal cat with blue eyes rides in the black mesh pet ball as it rolls slowly across the lawn, paws on the mesh floor, the ball rolling as one rigid sphere. In the background a woman gardener in a sun hat, long-sleeve shirt, jeans and green gardening gloves kneels by a flower bed holding a hand trowel, turns her head and smiles at the rolling ball. Real-world physics: nothing passes through the mesh, the cat never clips through the ball or the ground. Same cream snow Bengal and same black mesh ball as the references. Native ambient garden sound only, birds and the ball on grass, no music, no added sound effects, no speech. Her eyes stay on the ball. No text on screen.

shot on iphone 12, no warm lighting, no blur, nothing cinematic, make it look as organic as possible, remove the caption and the emojis. when recreating do not make the video grainy or sharp in any way, remake it as if it was freshly refilmed 4k iphone 12 footage.
